description: Set the project's loop section: the whole composition repeats once per value, with one field of one layer varying across the repeats. Builds one pass per value, each setting `field` of `elementId` to that value — e.g. a caption text layer cycling through several strings. Pass an empty `values` array to clear the loop (the comp plays once).

elementId.description: Target layer — text.<id>, image.<id>, shapes.<id>, or video.<id>.

field.description: The layer field each pass overrides — e.g. "text", "text_color", "filename". Defaults to "text".

projectId.description: Opaque project id (a v4 UUID, from list_projects/create_project). Selects which existing project this call mutates.

values.description: One value per loop pass. Empty array clears the loop.

name: set_loop
